stops.notes: Midosuji Illumination is ON until Dec 31. New Year (Dec 31–Jan 1) in Osaka: shrines for hatsumode, many shops closed Jan 1–3.
Hatsumode Jan 2–3 at Yasaka Shrine (go early). Toka Ebisu festival starts Jan 8 (our last day). Nishiki Market mostly closed until ~Jan 4–5; Ninomaru Palace closed Jan 1–3.

Jan 9 arrival: fukubukuro mostly over, some sales to mid-Jan. Illuminations active (Marunouchi/Shinjuku to ~Feb 14, Chuo Park to Jan 12). Yomiuriland Jewellumination Sat Jan 17/24. Day trip from here: kamakura-day-trip (Kamakura & Enoshima).
